name: Datasource
description: Read from or write to an external data API declared as a Datasource. The platform stores only the declaration — the data lives in the remote system.

properties.label: Datasource Key
properties.description: The key of the Datasource declaration (Admin → Datasources). E.g. vehicles

properties.label: Operation Key
properties.description: Which declared operation to run. Its kind (query / single / write) decides how the result is bound.

properties.label: Record Key
properties.description: Value for the operation's {{key}} placeholder — the record identifier. Required only when the operation's path contains {{key}}. FEEL supported, e.g. = plate

properties.label: Filters
properties.description: FEEL expression returning an object keyed by the operation's declared filter keys. Free-text search uses the reserved key `search`. E.g. = { search: plate, make: vehicleMake }

properties.label: Data
properties.description: Payload for a write operation's {{data}} placeholder. FEEL expression returning an object. E.g. = { plate: plate, vin: vin, make: make }

properties.label: Limit
properties.description: Maximum rows to return. Ignored by single/write operations.

properties.label: Offset
properties.description: Rows to skip. Leave empty and set Page instead to page by number.

properties.label: Page
properties.description: 1-based page number. Offset is derived from Page and Limit when Offset is empty.

properties.label: Result Variable
properties.description: Process variable to store the result in. A query stores { items, total }; a single or write stores the mapped record, or null when the record does not exist. Defaults to datasourceResult.

properties.label: Retries
properties.description: Attempts before the task fails. Reads default to 2. A write operation must be declared idempotent before this may exceed 0 — a retried non-idempotent write can duplicate the record, so the task is rejected before anything is sent.

properties.label: Retry Backoff
properties.description: ISO 8601 duration between attempts, e.g. PT10S
